author: Saranya-Nandakumar
body:
#### PR description:

**This PR contains the BTV DQM clean-up.** Most of the clean-up concerns the jet kinematics, so it is grouped here
with the other jet-kinematics changes:
- the duplicated per-discriminator copies of the jet kinematics are replaced by one set per tagger (item 3);
- the unused `jetMomentum` and `jetMultiplicity` histograms are removed (item 3);
- the double-filled UParT ALL histograms are fixed (item 1).

In total, about 1240 histograms removed (about 830 fewer) per workflow and the `Btag/` folder about half its size. Only the
DQM/validation code (DQMOffline/RecoB, Validation/RecoB) is touched.

1. **Fix double-filled UParT ALL histograms.** The UParT validation module used MClevel 4, which books the ALL
   histograms that the DQM module already books in the same folder, so every UParT ALL histogram was filled twice.
   The all-jet tag rate `jet{Eta,Phi}_diffEff_*ALL` read ~0.007 instead of ~0.3. UParT validation now uses MClevel 3
   (keeps the d/u/s/g split); `jetFlavour_*ALL` is always booked.
2. **Tag efficiency vs jet pT per flavour (`jetPt_diffEff`)**, next to the existing vs-eta/phi plots. Booked for the
   MiniAOD taggers (UParT, ParticleNet Forward). New `FlavourHistograms::divideRebinned()`.
3. **Tagger jet kinematics once per tagger; drop jetMomentum and jetMultiplicity.** Every discriminator of a MiniAOD
   tagger filled the same jets, so the jet kinematics were bin-identical in all 18 UParT discriminator folders.
   They now go to one folder per tagger and eta region, booked by one discriminator (UParT BvsAll, PNet Forward
   QvsG). New parameters `kinematicsTag` / `bookKinematics`; `bTagMiniDQM_cff.py` checks that exactly one
   discriminator per tagger books them. `jetMomentum` (no information beyond pT and eta) and `jetMultiplicity`
   (one entry per event) have no consumer in the release and are removed (MiniAOD taggers and AOD JP).
4. **Jet pT up to 7 TeV (`jetPt_extended`).** `jetPt` ([0, 350] GeV, 1 GeV bins) has up to 46 % of QCD jets (78 % of
   light jets) in the overflow. It is kept unchanged for the low-pT region, and `jetPt_extended` is added next to it:
   700 x 10 GeV on [0, 7000] (similar to JME). The new `jetPt_diffEff` (140 x 50 GeV on [0, 7000]) is
   divided by `jetPt_extended`.
5. **Fill the absolute jet flavour.** `jetFlavour` was filled with the signed flavour on [-0.5, 21.5]: up to 51 %
   underflow (antiquarks).

Folder changes for RelMon (MiniAOD taggers):
- The jet kinematics `jetPt/jetEta/jetPhi/jetFlavour` move out of the discriminator folders `Btag/UParT_<discr>_<region>`
  and `Btag/ParticleNetForward_QvsG_<region>` into `Btag/UParT_<region>` (`UParT_GLOBAL`, `UParT_ETA_0-1v4`,
  `UParT_ETA_1v4-2v5`) and `Btag/ParticleNetForward_ETA_2v5-5`. The content is the same as the former BvsAll / QvsG copy.
- `jetMomentum_*` and `jetMultiplicity_*` are removed everywhere, including AOD `Btag/JP_*`.
- Per workflow: 1239 (Run 3) / 1233 (Phase-2) histograms removed, 408 / 405 added (kinematics in the new folders
  incl. `jetPt_extended`, `jetPt_diffEff`, `jetFlavour_*ALL`).
- UParT ALL histograms have half the entries; the plain histograms keep the same mean and RMS.

#### PR validation:

`scram b` without warnings. 
runTheMatrix steps 3+4 of workflows 16834.0 (Run 3 2025) and 29634.0 (Phase-2 D110), 100 events, compared with plain master: all steps exit 0. 
The removed and added histograms are exactly the ones listed above. The moved jetPt/jetEta/jetPhi are bin-identical to the former copies (UParT ALL: half, item 1).
Data: T0 PromptReco config (`RunPromptReco.py`, ppEra_Run3_2024, BTagMu Run2024I RAW, 1000 events), which runs
`BTagPerformanceAnalyzerOnData`:
- exit 0, no BTV errors;
- 101 histograms removed (kinematics copies, jetMomentum/jetMultiplicity incl. JP), 38 added (incl. `jetPt_extended`).

Not a backport.
title: Btv dqm tagger kinematics: tagger kinematics once per tagger, efficiency vs jet pT, jet pT up to 7 TeV (jetPt_extended)
